summary:
Kogoro felt whatever was beyond deja vu; he had been here before but he could see the same situation coming at him from down the pipeline. Late nights and lost, hungry kids. Time was a flat circle shaped like an empty dinner plate.
. . .
Kogoro's plans to be miserable on his birthday are ruined by rain, clocks, and one of his stupid kids shambling through the door.
